profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Experienced programmer with a demonstrated history of working in the corporate as well as the higher education industry. Strong research professional with a master's degree concentrated on Deep Learning and focus on Image Classification. Have experience in AWS (Lambda, S3, SES, SNS), Python programming, Machine Learning, NLP based product design and implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built new libraries (GO) for microservice architecture and leveraged frameworks like gin.
Developed full stack application framework with real-time web-sockets streaming in Golang.
Managed docker orchestration and docker containerization using ECR, EC2, and Kubernetes.
Focused on automation and configuration management for micro-services.
Implemented RESTful API services to work as a middleware between our application and third-party APIs.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Working on AI based healthcare software design and development. Also, implementing machine learning and data mining techniques for weather informatics.

positions.title: Artificial Intelligence Programmer
positions.description: Used AI algorithms, Natural Language Processing techniques, and other Text mining analytics to develop software programs for analyzing receipts. In addition, to design and develop AI-based techniques for developing recommendations by mining IHR data stores. Further, work closely and in tandem with UI, Backend, and receipt parsing teams and provide integrated IHR software solutions

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Played a key role in building custom UI components/modules which were implemented as part of the business requirement across the web application and developing intuitive user interface for the same. Designed custom MVC framework and functioned as a subject matter expert on Oracle’s Weblogic, BPEL, ADF.

educations.schoolName: Indian Institute of Technology (Banaras Hindu University), Varanasi
